name: Grace Kowalski
source:
Grace Kowalski works as a librarian at City Hall. Her twin sister, [url=/c176667]Hannah[/url] is also a librarian. How does that happen? Well, they are twins. A rough start in their life has forced them to toughen up. Abandoned by their parents at 5 months old, the sisters have grown incredibly close. Grace tries to put up a hard exterior, mimicking her sister, but she is a softy at heart and finds it hard to keep up with Hannah, who is more naturally icy.

[Edited from in-game description]
